criteria.luke-10-33: Inner parable instant only: the Samaritan and the wounded traveler at the roadside. No Jesus, lawyer, departed priest/Levite, robbers or innkeeper selected or described. Every described actor selected. One instant across all scene fields; grounding quotes anchor each selected entry in 10:33 itself.
criteria.luke-10-34: Allowed only after accepting the exact 10:33 artifact. One representative instant from the multi-action verse (for example treating wounds, lifting onto the animal, or arriving at the inn), never two successive poses. No innkeeper: the host first appears in 10:35. The inn may appear only if the chosen instant is at the inn. Every described actor selected.
criteria.daniel-7-9: Independent of the Luke verdict once the Luke case is recorded. Narrator Daniel is not depicted inside the vision from 'I watched'. No ministering assembly or attendants imported from the shared look or 7:10's 'thousands'; 7:9 itself establishes thrones, the Ancient of Days' throne, fire and wheels. The no-form subject stays effects-based with no body, face, hair or clothing; repeating a prohibited figure as a denial is recorded as an instruction gap, not a blocker.
criteria.daniel-7-10: Allowed only after accepting the exact 7:9 artifact. The ministering assembly may appear because 7:10 names it; no narrator; no-form constraints hold; one instant (court seated and books opened, or the fiery stream with the assembly), not both as successive stages.
criteria.refusal: A code refusal (unavailable) writes no plan and is retained as a held case: the guard worked, but the moment cannot yet be illustrated.
